items.statement: The submission identifies the exact 6I3U receptor and exact A36 chemical record, and documents independent pose generation, deduplication and selection before simulation.
items.expected: Unique record identifiers, formal charge/multiplicity, pose identities, and a reproducible selection rationale are provided.

items.statement: The reported trajectory is preceded by minimization/equilibration and is analyzed with explicit atom selections and hydrogen-bond criteria.
items.expected: Validation covers minimization, equilibration, imaging/centering, ligand retention and convergence, with analysis definitions.

items.statement: The complex reaches an RMSD plateau after equilibration rather than showing unbounded drift.
items.expected: A post-equilibration RMSD time-window summary and uncertainty/replicate context support a stable plateau.

items.statement: The trajectory supports low residue flexibility and persistent protein–ligand hydrogen bonding consistent with a stable complex.
items.expected: RMSF distribution and hydrogen-bond count/occupancy are reported with definitions and limitations.
